sizeGuide.title: Size guide
sizeGuide.intro: All measurements are in centimetres. Measure directly on your body with a soft tape, without pulling it tight.

steps.bust: Measure around the fullest part of your bust, keeping the tape level with the floor.
steps.chest: Measure around the widest part of your chest, just under the armpits.
steps.waist: Measure around the narrowest part of your waist, about 2–3 cm above the belly button.
steps.hips: Stand with your feet together and measure around the widest part of your hips and seat.
steps.inseam: For swim shorts: measure along the inside of your leg, from the crotch to where you'd like the shorts to end.
steps.height: Stand barefoot with your back against a wall and measure from the floor to the top of the head.

sizeGuide.fitTip: Between sizes? For swimwear, go by your hips for bottoms and your bust for tops. Prefer a less snug fit – size up.
sizeGuide.yourSizes: This product's sizes are shown in the chart.
sizeGuide.noChart: This product comes in its own sizes, so there's no general chart. We're happy to help you choose.
